text: D232403 applies a request to reject duplicate created folder IDs, while the reviewer explicitly defers the stronger ordering check after rebutting the author claim that order does not matter. The historical idsCreated Set checks membership/duplicates but not response order. At fixed0b93 runSimpleSyncTest asserts the created-ID iteration array against a specific sequence. Preserve this distinction when reading coverage; historical approval does not prove deferred ordering coverage existed in that landing. The reviewer protocol rationale is attributed; no independent full EWS ID-response mapping or runtime test was performed.
title: EWS folder-sync tests distinguish unique membership from processing order
